review_candidates.title: Lead Developer Experience & Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: What we do Hospitals should be able to focus on patients, not administrative overhead. Damedic takes over the full hospital case billing process: our in-house medical coding experts work hand in hand with our AI-based coding platform. Together, we are shaping the coding processes of tomorrow — efficient, reliable, and with human expertise at the center. Why we need you AI-native processes are fundamentally changing what infrastructure means. What used to be mainly Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and CI/CD is now also about a bigger question: How do we create a development environment where AI agents, automation, internal knowledge, and engineering processes work together securely, meaningfully, and at scale? There is no blueprint for this transformation — and this is exactly where you come in. You take ownership and actively shape the path forward: through smart processes, sustainable standards, modern tools, and close collaboration with the teams. What you can expect Team play & modern Developer Experience Leadership on equal footing: You take on both disciplinary and functional leadership of our two-person DevEx team. You see yourself as a team player and enabler who drives engineering productivity together with the team. DevEx in the AI era: For you, DevEx is much more than local setup and deployments. You shape the conditions for modern engineering work: from context engineering for AI agents and standards for skills to development processes for knowledge management and the tools around it. Processes as enablers: You turn best practices into shared standards. You create ease of mind for developers and make the organization as a whole more effective. Measurable success: You measure the impact of your work through company development and direct feedback, as well as key KPIs such as our internal DevEx Index and DORA metrics. Platform operations, evolution & automation Operations & cloud: You are responsible for the stable operation of our AWS/EKS landscape as well as our on-premise system. Incident & alert management: You optimize the first-responder process, including improvements to our DevOps assistant. Platform evolution: You continuously develop our infrastructure to strengthen IT security, establish best practices, and improve cost efficiency. Compliance & resilience: You ensure that all processes are aligned with our compliance certifications, including ISO 27001 and BSI C5. Why us? Infrastructure as a growth lever: At Damedic, infrastructure is not just operations. It is a central productivity lever for engineering and product development. Room to shape: You actively define what Developer Experience, infrastructure, and AI-native ways of working will mean at Damedic going forward. Direct impact: Your work directly influences how fast, secure, and productive our engineering teams can be. Healthcare with purpose: Our technology helps hospitals reduce administrative workload and focus more on patient care. Remote with a personal touch: We work remote-first within Germany, cover the costs of home office equipment or a co-working space, meet in person regularly — and we add a Deutschlandticket on top. A typical day at Damedic In the morning, you analyze an overnight scaling bottleneck in the cluster: stabilize quickly, understand the root cause, and improve monitoring and architecture. Later, you roll out an automated development setup more broadly, collect feedback from engineers, and turn a good tool into a widely used standard. In a design session with a product team, you help reduce technical complexity and choose sensible standard components instead of custom-built solutions where appropriate. In the afternoon, you prioritize the most important DevEx and infrastructure topics with Engineering Leads: What needs a tool? What needs a standard? What needs better documentation or enablement? Your profile The foundation: You have built, operated, and further developed complex production systems. Developer mindset: You think like a developer. You solve problems through good tools, clear processes, and meaningful automation — you do not just manage problems, you build solutions. The stack: You are confident in a modern cloud landscape around AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. You already cover parts of our extended stack, such as PostgreSQL, Airflow, Prometheus, Go, Python, Kotlin, React, GitLab, and Atlassian. Pragmatic AI approach: AI tools and agents are part of your standard toolkit. You enjoy experimenting, but you also know when a simple script is the more stable choice. Your leadership style: You provide clarity and orientation, listen actively, and help others succeed — because their success is your success. Bonus, but not required Experience with ISO 27001, BSI C5, or SOC 2 German language skills are helpful, but not required You are a good fit if … you do not just want to operate infrastructure, but make engineering teams sustainably more productive; you can combine technical depth with enablement, communication, and pragmatism; you see standards as enablers that free up developers’ minds and make the organization more effective; you read incidents and manual workarounds as valuable signals for structural improvement. What this role is not This role is not a firefighting job for infrastructure problems and not a ticket loop for deployments, permissions, setups, and short-term workarounds. Of course, you will work on operational topics. But your actual mission is different: you build structures, standards, and tools that enable engineering teams to work more independently, more securely, and more productively. And this is not a fully built setup with a playbook sitting on the shelf. We are looking for someone who shapes, prioritizes, experiments, measures impact, and takes Developer Experience and infrastructure at Damedic to the next level.

Was dich bei uns erwartet: Dein Arbeitsalltag ist vielseitig – genauso wie unsere Kunden und Projekte. Du arbeitest an Marken aus unterschiedlichen Branchen und begleitest sie sowohl projektbezogen als auch über eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit hinweg. Deine Aufgaben bewegen sich unter anderem in diesen Bereichen: Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Marken und Corporate Designs Konzeption und Gestaltung von digitalen und analogen Anwendungen UX/UI-Design und Webdesign Print- und Editorial-Design Entwicklung von Kampagnen und Kommunikationsideen Mitarbeit an Marken-, Kommunikations- und Designstrategien Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Markenwelten Übernahme kleinerer Projekte und eigener Verantwortungsbereiche direkter Austausch mit Kunden Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach einzelne Aufgaben ab. Arbeiten bei Kontraste: Wir sind ein junges Unternehmen mit kurzen Wegen, viel Eigenverantwortung und der Möglichkeit, Dinge wirklich mitzugestalten. review_candidates.description: HEAD OF POWER DEPARTMENT - ICC GROUP We're Hiring: Head of Power Department at ICC Group Are you a visionary engineering leader with a passion for driving impactful energy and infrastructure projects across emerging markets? International Consolidated Contractors (ICC) Group is expanding rapidly, and we are looking for an exceptional Head of Power Department to join our leadership team at our headquarters in Beirut, Lebanon. At ICC Group, we hold a market-leading position in delivering EPC projects across Africa, the Middle East, and the Gulf. From solar and hybrid power plants to substations, transmission lines, and distribution networks, we are powering the future. ROLE SUMMARY As the Head of Power Department, you will be the technical, engineering, and commercial compass for our entire power portfolio. You will lead a dedicated team of circa 20 engineers and oversee a diverse, multi-country portfolio of high-impact projects. This senior leadership role requires a rare blend of deep technical mastery, sharp commercial acumen, and the managerial gravitas to represent ICC at the highest levels with international partners. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Technical and Engineering Leadership Direct the full EPC lifecycle for conventional and renewable power generation, substations, and HV/MV/LV distribution networks. Set rigorous technical standards and ensure compliance with international codes. Provide senior technical oversight and problem resolution across concurrent multi-country projects. Strategic Partner Engagement Lead technical negotiations with international partners and OEMs. Evaluate generation technologies, plant configurations, and equipment packages. Advise executive management on optimal technical and commercial solutions. Represent ICC as the senior technical authority with clients, partners, lenders, and government counterparts. Commercial Strategy and Estimation Own the pricing and estimation for power tenders. Build BOQs, cost models, and bid build-ups with high accuracy and commercial judgment. Drive bid strategy, identify risks and opportunities, and optimize tendered prices while protecting margins. Review and challenge cost assumptions and OEM quotations to secure the strongest commercial position. Joint Venture and Partner Negotiation Lead technical and commercial negotiations with JV and consortium partners. Assess partner capability, technical fit, and scope split. Structure roles and responsibilities within joint ventures and consortia. Build and maintain a network of credible international technology and EPC partners. Team Leadership and Project Management Lead, mentor, and develop a department of approximately 20 electrical and power engineers. Plan and allocate engineering resources across multiple simultaneous projects in different countries. Monitor and supervise project progress, budgets, schedules, and technical performance remotely from Lebanon, with travel to project sites as required. Establish departmental processes, reporting, and controls aligned with the Group's growth. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Education and Experience Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Power Engineering (Master's degree or MBA is an advantage). 20+ years of progressive experience in the power sector within an EPC or contracting environment, with substantial experience in senior leadership and department-head roles. Proven track record leading the EPC delivery of power generation plants, substations, transmission lines, and/or distribution networks. Demonstrated experience heading or deputy-heading a power or electrical department with direct responsibility for engineering teams. Hands-on experience in tendering, pricing, and estimation for large-scale power projects. Experience working across multiple countries, ideally including Africa, the Middle East, and/or the Gulf region. Chartered or professional engineering status (e.g., PE, CEng, or equivalent) is an advantage. Technical Expertise Expert command of power generation (solar, hybrid, gas, HFO, combined cycle), substations (HV/MV), transmission lines, and HV/MV/LV distribution networks. Strong grasp of EPC execution, grid codes, international standards (IEC/IEEE), and procurement of major electromechanical equipment. Commercial Acumen Advanced capability in cost estimation, pricing, BOQ build-up, and bid strategy. Sound commercial and contractual judgment, including familiarity with FIDIC-based contracts. Leadership and Interpersonal Skills Proven managerial gravitas and the ability to lead, motivate, and grow a sizeable engineering team. Excellent negotiation skills and executive presence with international partners, clients, and authorities. Strong organizational ability to manage and supervise multiple cross-border projects in parallel. Fluency in English; French and/or Arabic is an advantage given the Group's markets. WHAT ICC OFFERS Join us at the heart of a fast-growing, market-leading EPC group. You will have direct exposure to executive management, shape a department poised for significant growth, and leave your mark on some of the world's most dynamic infrastructure markets. This is a unique opportunity to build and lead a power department positioned for substantial expansion across Africa, the Middle East, and the Gulf region. ABOUT ICC GROUP International Consolidated Contractors (ICC) Group is a leading EPC contractor delivering power, energy, and infrastructure projects across Africa, the Middle East, and the Gulf. The Group holds a market-leading position in solar and hybrid power plants and generation, alongside a growing portfolio of substations, transmission lines, and distribution networks.
